topic: SQL query for airport session data
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on refining a complex SQL query to extract device session data from an airport environment, specifically targeting sessions detected near gates. The initial request was for all sessions recorded for devices whose last detection occurred at Gate2 two hours before departure. Multiple iterations of the query were provided and reviewed.

The final version added logic to display the facility name alongside the facility number in the SELECT statement.
decisions: The SQL query structure was finalized to extract device sessions based on gate proximity and timing relative to airport departures.
action_items: Someone will process the final SQL query using Python for further KPI extraction, including dwell-time calculation and filtering short sessions.
